metadata.title: Tian Yuandong Again: RSI at a $4.65B Valuation and AI Self-Evolution | Neolabs
metadata.guest_role: Co-founder, Recursive Superintelligence (RSI) · former Meta FAIR research director

conclusion: Months after Meta FAIR exit, Yuandong Tian joins Recursive Superintelligence (RSI): eight co-founders, $650M raised, $4.65B valuation, no product yet. Thesis is recursive self-improvement — AI that automates research to strengthen AI — sold on team pedigree (MetaMind/Salesforce, DeepMind alumni, Cresta operators). He frames top capital as still betting people in a fast-moving field, runway as 1–3 years of compute, and auto-research machinery as the productized secret sauce amid coding-agent wars and Anthropic/OpenAI/Google shifts.
background: San Francisco video podcast revisit after a prior layoff interview. Conversation ranges across why leave Meta after ~11 years, how Muse Spark/distillation controversies look from inside alumni networks, world models vs LeCun's AMI Labs, and whether Anthropic's coding lead lasts as Codex and Google Antigravity catch up.
important_facts: RSI raise: $650M at $4.65B with eight co-founders before product — Tian argues top capital buys people and execution adaptability when roadmaps rot in weeks. Co-founder fabric includes Richard Socher/MetaMind–Salesforce lineage, Cresta-building operators into recursive vision, Tim Rocktäschel (Meta→DeepMind) credited for fundraising credibility. Internal progress 'better than expected'; runway roughly 1–3 years because GPUs eat cash.

Technical bet: recursive self-improvement / automated research loops — build machinery that researches and understands automatically, publishable results with secret-sauce methods as black box; latent reasoning discussed as part of the frontier. Goal is self-improving systems, not a single chat app demo.

Market color: Anthropic narrative strong on commercialization and IPO path; coding agents contested as OpenAI Codex closes and Google ships Antigravity; Tian says ranking is unstable. Meta chapter: ~11 years, felt the lab no longer needed as many people — exit as chance to find meaning; comments on forced distillation controversies and Muse Spark from an alumni vantage.

mental_model.name: Team Bet × Recursive Loop × Compute Runway
mental_model.components: In frontier AI, seed checks clear on founder graphs when products cannot be specified; the company is a research factory that turns self-improvement into a productizable system under a finite GPU runway.
mental_model.application: Private:RSI is a high-beta talent compounder — diligence co-founder cohesion and published 'wow' demos before next raise. META talent outflow remains a watch item; Anthropic/OpenAI/Google coding race sets the competitive weather.

key_insights.view: Top capital still underwrites people first.
key_insights.question: Why $4.65B with no product?
key_insights.answer: Roadmaps expire; investors buy teams that can re-aim weekly and already earned trust at Meta/DeepMind/Salesforce exits.

key_insights.question: What ships?
key_insights.answer: A machinery that produces impressive research outcomes while methods stay proprietary — research-as-product.

key_insights.question: Does Anthropic stay ahead?
key_insights.answer: Commercial momentum is real, but Codex/Antigravity show the slot can flip — RSI avoids hinging on today's chatbot ranking.

top_investment_implications.thesis: Pedigree + recursive SI narrative cleared a huge seed; still pre-product, compute runway finite — low confidence
FAIR alumni leaving to neolabs is a talent signal; distillation controversy is culture risk — low
Episode paints strong 2026 commercial/IPO narrative in coding — contested, low confidence

golden_quotes: Top capital still bets on people.
Big labs don't need that many people anymore.

events.event: Internal progress reportedly ahead of plan; 1–3y runway
Industry races on coding agents / auto-research
